fields.urlHelpAnthropic: Use the base URL only, without /v1 — for example https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic. The /v1/messages part is added automatically, so a trailing /v1 makes the request fail.
fields.urlHelpFoundry: The resource base URL only — for example https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com. Do not add /openai/v1 or /anthropic; the path is chosen per model from its API protocol.
fields.urlHelpAzureOpenAI: The resource base URL only — for example https://<resource>.openai.azure.com. Serves OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions under /openai/v1; Anthropic models need a Microsoft Foundry or Anthropic endpoint.

o200k_tile.label: o200k-tile — gpt-4o, gpt-4.1, gpt-5.x (exact)
o200k_tile.hint: OpenAI o200k_base tokenizer. Exact for gpt-4o, gpt-4.1 and gpt-5.x. Images priced per 512px tile.

o200k_patch_1_62.label: o200k-patch-1.62 — gpt-4.1-mini / nano (exact)
o200k_patch_1_62.hint: OpenAI o200k_base tokenizer with patch-priced images. Exact text count for gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-4.1-nano and other patch-priced OpenAI models.

cl100k_tile.label: cl100k-tile — gpt-4, gpt-3.5 (exact)
cl100k_tile.hint: OpenAI cl100k_base tokenizer. Exact for gpt-4 and gpt-3.5.

anthropic_estimate.label: anthropic-estimate — Claude (estimate, 3.5 chars/token)
anthropic_estimate.hint: Estimate for Claude models: 3.5 characters per token, 750 pixels per image token. Anthropic publishes no offline tokenizer.

char_est_4.label: char-est-4 — DeepSeek, Llama, Grok, others without a public tokenizer (estimate, 4 chars/token)
char_est_4.hint: Estimate for models without a public tokenizer: 4 characters per token. Shown as approximate in the meter.

char_est_3_5.label: char-est-3.5 — models without a public tokenizer (estimate, 3.5 chars/token)
char_est_3_5.hint: Estimate for models without a public tokenizer: 3.5 characters per token. Shown as approximate in the meter.

word_count.label: word-count — any model (rough estimate, 1 token/word)
word_count.hint: Rough estimate that counts whitespace-separated words. Shown as approximate in the meter.

delete.title: Delete Model
delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this model?

fields.temperatureHint: gpt-5.x models only accept a temperature while reasoning is switched off. Claude Opus/Sonnet reject it entirely.
fields.supportedEffortsHint: Leave all unchecked for a model that does not reason. Omit "None" for a model that always reasons and cannot be asked not to.
fields.tokenCountingSchemeHint: Drives the context-window meter. Pick the tokenizer that fits the model; the generic estimates cover models without a public tokenizer. "No counter" hides the meter.
fields.tokenCountingSchemeCustom: A hand-entered scheme variant kept from an earlier save.
fields.apiProtocolRequired: Required. Requests to this model fail until a protocol is set.
fields.apiProtocolHint: How the model is spoken to on the wire. The endpoint's host adds the matching path, e.g. /openai/v1 or /anthropic on Microsoft Foundry.
fields.knownModelHint: Fills in the capabilities we have verified for this model. Everything stays editable.
fields.allowedRolesRequired: Pick at least one role, or nobody will see this model.
fields.allowedAsDefault: Can be a default assistant model
fields.allowedAsDefaultHelp: Lets users pin an assistant built on this model as their default for every new chat. Leave off for expensive models. It does not affect who may use the model — that is Allowed roles.

settings.title: General settings
settings.intro: Choose which of the registered models ChatUiT uses for its built-in tasks.

fields.defaultModelHelp: Preselected in the model list when creating a new assistant.
fields.chatNamingModelHelp: Used to generate a name for a new chat from the first message. New chats keep their placeholder name when this is not selected.
fields.defaultAssistantHelp: The system assistant a new chat starts on when the user has not pinned one of their own.

fields.enabledHelp: Off switches the tool off for everyone, whatever the roles and groups say.
fields.allowedGroupsHelp: A user in any listed Entra group may use the tool, in addition to the roles above.
fields.nobodyWarning: No roles and no groups: nobody can use this tool.
fields.overridden: This tool uses a custom policy saved {{date}}.
fields.usingDefault: This tool uses its code default.
fields.functionsHelp: This tool is an internal agent. These are the functions it may call on the user's behalf; they have no separate access policies.

actions.resetConfirm: Drop the custom policy and go back to the code default?

agents.title: Internal agents
agents.intro: Agents defined in code. Each runs on the model set here, in chats through its tool and in the API.

fields.functionsHelp: The functions the agent may call on the user's behalf. They have no separate access policies.
fields.modelHelp: Only models that support function calling are listed. Applies to every run of the agent, in chats and in the API.
fields.notSetHelp: No model is set. In chats the agent runs on the chat's model. The API cannot use it.
fields.reasoningEffortHelp: Only the levels the selected model accepts are offered.

api.title: API
api.intro: Agents and models served to API clients such as the Office add-ins, through the Responses API. An entry only admits callers: an agent's own default, or a model's roles, still apply.

fields.publicIdHelp: What clients send as model. Lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'; it cannot be changed later.
fields.agentModelHelp: Set under Internal agents. The API cannot use an agent without a model.
fields.targetModelHelp: Callers must also hold one of the model's allowed roles.
fields.enabledHelp: Off hides the entry from every caller.
fields.nobodyWarning: No roles and no groups: nobody can use this entry.

actions.deleteConfirm: Remove this entry? Clients using it get model_not_found.

status.title: Status
status.resolved: What the server resolved from your token
status.noGroupsClaim: The token has no groups claim. Group-based access cannot work until the app registration emits one in the access token.
status.groupsOverage: The token carries a groups overage marker (too many groups to list). The server treats this as no groups. Use "Groups assigned to the application" in Entra.
